why: A valuation multiple on next year's earnings is another quantity and says nothing about the FY2028 gross margin.
A plan to deliver 100,000 GPUs for government workloads is about volume and demand, with no price, cost or margin figure.
A claim that chip sales will double is about revenue, a different quantity that does not set the gross margin percentage.
A robotics platform integration with Amazon shares only the company and gives nothing on FY2028 gross margin.
Hyperscaler data-center spending in 2026 is an industry demand figure for another period and does not feed the margin percentage.
Deploying 2 million GPUs at AWS in 2027-2028 is a volume figure with no pricing, mix or cost information for gross margin.
A 2030 global data-center capex estimate is an industry size forecast for another period, not a margin input.
A trailing price-to-earnings multiple is a valuation figure and does not bear on FY2028 gross margin.
